items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: we went to Biloxi with him, one of the Celestane's job, went to the Gulfport on Celestane's job with him.

ctx.x: By the way, Alvin Alcorn is working with that group now again. Yeah, he is. They don't have Fernandes anymore. No. Albert's finances quit? Well, I don't know. There's some, maybe a disagreement or something, and so they're using Alvin at present. Well, I tell you. For some time now, a few weeks or months at least, here.

You know, he lives up on my rod, and I know he, I see him pretty often. I always see his family. He is a good trumpet player, yet. I mean, usually the trumpet players' lips go bad, you know. But he is a good trumpet player, and he's a nice fellow to be around. Some of the musicians, you don't care about being around, I have to admit. That's right. He's a wonderful fellow. He is a nice fellow. Albert French had one of the best dispositions for musicians. It's always a grill. He's always a grill. I mean, anywhere…
Yeah, right. Went to Europe with him about two years, three years ago.
